The stay was satisfactory only! The hotel is located inside a market which is very narrow and crowded. No car parking facility available. We stayed at Room No: 201 for a day and the room had facilities such as TV, AC, water heater etc. But it was looking old and was not up to the price and expected standards. A bread omelette/bread toast for the complimentary breakfast along with tea. A water bottle should have been provided as a freebie since it is part of basic hospitality etiquette.
